title: Omnipod Dash Connection Problem
body:
After enabling notifications in Android Auto I have the same problem that occured with the introduction of Andorid 15.
I also enabled "find near devices" for Android Auto (https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/RemoteFeatures/AndroidAuto.html).

What I already done: Resetting Bluetooth Connections, Reinstalling AAPS
On another phone with Android 15 and the same Build it works after importing preferences

Would appreciate any help.

AAPS 3.3.1.0
Build: 2ac634c908-2025.01.09
Google Pixel 9 Pro with Android 15

(works here: Google Pixel 8 with same build)

comments.body: We cannot help more. This is related to phone's BT stack. Sorry
